scope: All tracked working files and staged index blobs
Credential prefixes/private keys/credential assignments/URLs and high-entropy Python literals
Personal absolute paths, email candidates and host-environment references
Eleven PDFs: metadata, XMP, visible text, links, decoded objects/streams and attachments
Git local config key names, refs, reachable commits and old staged object exclusion
remediation: Removed a user-specific interpreter path from an optional PowerShell launcher.
Made a second optional launcher use portable interpreter discovery.
Retained original observed protocol separately; public bindings record only the two launcher adaptations. Scientific Python files and scientific settings are unchanged.
Moved ignored build logs, bytecode and preaudit Git objects outside public repository.
Recreated clean local Git index, with no commits or personal commit email metadata.
Moved superseded public ZIP and detached report outside publication paths; rebuilt artifacts after audit.
Removed detailed host OS build from public toolchain summary.

reviewed_false_positives.email_patterns: Matrix multiplication in Python, not email strings.
reviewed_false_positives.UNC_patterns: LaTeX syntax/regex and incidental compressed PDF bytes.
reviewed_false_positives.PDF_byte_patterns: No corresponding matches in interpreted PDF content or metadata.

provenance_paths: Project-relative iteration/code/result names retained for scientific source identity; no personal machine directory prefixes.

git.visibility: User states private; visibility settings not independently queried by Git ref inspection.

limitations: Pattern matching and manual disposition are not a guarantee against every possible sensitive value.
Live remote visibility/settings are outside Git ref inspection.
Public GitHub handles and scholarly citation names are intentionally retained.
final_scan_review: All remaining candidates match individually reviewed false-positive signatures; no new or unresolved candidates.
superseded_artifacts: Earlier preaudit public ZIP, report, local Git index and raw builds quarantined outside publication tree. Use the replacement archive.

collective_attribution_revision.scope: New paper/citation/disclosure and staged files rescanned after attribution update; remaining candidates match reviewed mathematical/LaTeX/compressed-byte false positives.

record_phase: Prepublication audit snapshot. Zero-commit/no-push/ref counts describe that audit phase, not the ongoing live repository state.
